name: Hilde Vautmans - § 1, point l - Am 16
title: REPORT on a European Parliament recommendation to the Council, the Commission and the Vice-President of the Commission / High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy concerning EU-China political relations
part_text: l) acknowledge that overdependencies on Chinese technologies and resources in the area of climate change prevention and green transition render the EU vulnerable and must be addressed; recognise, however, that cooperation with China in the field of green technology remains essential for European companies, given China’s position in the production and refining of critical raw materials and in the supply of clean-technology components; call for a balanced approach that combines de-risking and diversification of supply chains with sustained engagement with Beijing on areas of mutual interest, including climate action, renewable energy deployment and green innovation, in order to ensure both the competitiveness of European industries and the achievement of the EU’s climate objectives;
